metadata.description: Multi-category ground-truth benchmark dataset for empirical compliance auditing of 8 dark-pattern categories on Indian and Global E-Commerce platforms.
metadata.ground_truth_methodology: Dual-annotator consensus labeling with legal taxonomy mapping to Indian Consumer Protection (CCPA) 2023 Guidelines and international dark pattern taxonomies.
metadata.evaluation_split_policy: Stratified 70/30 train/test split with deterministic random seed 42 to prevent data leakage.
metadata.insufficient_evidence_policy: Samples marked INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE represent ambiguous or incomplete DOM states; tracked explicitly for coverage analysis.

samples.text: Hurry! Sale ends in 04:59 minutes! Price will increase after countdown expires.
samples.label: DARK_PATTERN
samples.rationale: Artificial countdown timer that resets to 04:59 upon page reload, fabricating time pressure.

samples.text: Only 2 items left in stock! 34 customers are viewing this item right now.
samples.label: DARK_PATTERN
samples.rationale: Synthetic low-stock warning paired with fake social proof ticker to force rapid checkout.

samples.text: High demand warning: 89% of deal claimed! Reservation holds for 5 minutes only.
samples.label: DARK_PATTERN
samples.rationale: Fabricated claim percentage and looping artificial cart reservation countdown.

samples.text: Flash deal ends in 02:15! Buy immediately or lose 40% discount forever.
samples.label: DARK_PATTERN
samples.rationale: Manipulative urgency countdown resetting across user browsing sessions.

samples.text: Last chance: 1 room remaining at this special rate on our platform!
samples.label: DARK_PATTERN
samples.rationale: Misleading scarcity notification contradicted by real inventory availability.

samples.text: Summer Collection 2026 available now. Explore new seasonal arrivals.
samples.label: BENIGN

samples.label: BENIGN

samples.text: Special Offer

samples.text: Order Total: ₹1,499. Mandatory platform convenience fee of ₹99 added at checkout.
samples.label: DARK_PATTERN
samples.rationale: Unavoidable platform charge concealed from headline product price and injected during payment.

samples.text: Flight Fare: ₹3,200. Passenger handling surcharge of ₹450 appended at final confirmation.
samples.label: DARK_PATTERN
samples.rationale: Mandatory handling fee partitioned from initial search results, violating CCPA 2023 pricing rules.

samples.text: Room Rate ₹2,500/night. Mandatory resort facility charge of ₹600/night added before booking.
samples.label: DARK_PATTERN
samples.rationale: Hidden resort fee disclosed incrementally at the end of the booking funnel.

samples.text: Food items: ₹540. Added undisclosed packaging fee ₹40 and delivery partner surge ₹50.
samples.label: DARK_PATTERN
samples.rationale: Mandatory packaging surcharge incremental drip added after item selection.

samples.text: Movie Ticket: ₹250. Internet handling fee of ₹45.50 added at checkout payment screen.
samples.label: DARK_PATTERN
samples.rationale: Inescapable internet handling fee excluded from ticket selection display.

samples.text: All-inclusive price: ₹1,999 (Inclusive of all applicable GST, taxes, and shipping fees).
samples.label: BENIGN
samples.rationale: Transparent headline pricing clearly stating that all taxes and logistics fees are included.

samples.text: Product Price: ₹800 + Goods and Services Tax (GST 18% ₹144) = Total ₹944 clearly itemized.
samples.label: BENIGN
samples.rationale: Statutory government tax explicitly broken down upfront in accordance with tax laws.

samples.text: Subtotal: ₹1,200. Free shipping applied. Zero convenience fees. Total payable: ₹1,200.
samples.label: BENIGN
samples.rationale: Zero hidden fees with upfront price confirmation matching final payable amount.

samples.text: Express Delivery option selected (+₹100 optional speed delivery). Standard delivery is ₹0.
samples.label: BENIGN
samples.rationale: Voluntary expedited delivery selected by user with free standard alternative available.

samples.text: Taxes and fees may apply depending on delivery location.
samples.label: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
samples.rationale: Pre-checkout statement without final cart pricing data; insufficient context to determine drip pricing.

samples.text: Advertised item unavailable. Switched to alternative model for ₹1,899 at checkout.
samples.label: DARK_PATTERN
samples.rationale: Consumer lured by advertised low-cost item then redirected to more expensive substitute.

samples.text: Promotional deal replaced: Advertised ₹499 price no longer valid, updated price is ₹1,199.
samples.label: DARK_PATTERN
samples.rationale: Arbitrary unilateral price hike applied after user clicked promotional banner.

samples.text: Out of stock. Selected product replaced with similar item in cart automatically.
samples.label: DARK_PATTERN
samples.rationale: Automatic substitution of unchosen product into cart without explicit consumer confirmation.

samples.text: Headline free trial offer switches to immediate billed charge upon account submission.
samples.label: DARK_PATTERN
samples.rationale: Promised free trial swapped with immediate upfront debit without clear disclosure.

samples.text: Special discount banner links to standard non-discounted checkout page without notice.
samples.label: DARK_PATTERN
samples.rationale: Deceptive banner funnel failing to deliver advertised promotional terms.

samples.text: Product exactly matches description. Delivered item: Wireless Earbuds Black (₹999).
samples.label: BENIGN
samples.rationale: Exact match between advertised specifications, cart items, and billing details.

samples.text: This item is currently out of stock. We will notify you when it becomes available.
samples.label: BENIGN
samples.rationale: Honest stock notification without deceptive automatic substitutions.

samples.text: You have selected Size XL (₹899). Price differs from Size S (₹799) as listed on table.
samples.label: BENIGN
samples.rationale: Transparent variant pricing clearly itemized in the size selector table.

samples.text: Similar items you may like: Optional recommendations carousel displayed below.
samples.label: BENIGN
samples.rationale: Standard product recommendation display without forced cart injection.

samples.text: Prices subject to change without notice based on market fluctuations.
samples.label: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
samples.rationale: Commodity pricing disclaimer without active evidence of deceptive switching.

samples.text: Decline offer
samples.label: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
samples.rationale: Neutral label; cannot evaluate contrastive emotional valence without accept pair.

samples.text: Only ₹199/month! *Billed as one non-refundable annual payment of ₹2,388.
samples.label: DARK_PATTERN
samples.rationale: Billing frequency obfuscation highlighting low monthly rate while locking into annual charge.

samples.text: Subscription renews automatically at regular price without notice. Cancel by calling phone support.
samples.label: DARK_PATTERN
samples.rationale: Asymmetric cancellation barrier requiring phone call to terminate digital subscription.

samples.text: Free trial converts automatically to paid continuous subscription. Cancellation fee applies.
samples.label: DARK_PATTERN
samples.rationale: Deceptive trial trap coupled with punitive cancellation penalty.

samples.text: To cancel your plan, submit a written letter 30 days prior to billing cycle.
samples.label: DARK_PATTERN
samples.rationale: Extreme friction barrier obstructing consumer statutory right to terminate service.

samples.text: Introductory rate of ₹99 increases to ₹899 after month 1 with mandatory 12-month lock-in.
samples.label: DARK_PATTERN
samples.rationale: Steep price escalation combined with concealed contract lock-in period.

samples.text: Monthly plan: ₹299 billed monthly. Cancel anytime online with 1-click in account settings.
samples.label: BENIGN
samples.rationale: Transparent monthly billing with frictionless self-serve online cancellation.

samples.text: Annual plan: ₹2,400 billed annually (save 20% vs monthly ₹250). Clear renewal reminders sent 7 days prior.
samples.label: BENIGN
samples.rationale: Prominent annual price disclosure with automated pre-renewal notice commitment.

samples.text: 7-Day Free Trial. No credit card required. Account expires automatically unless you upgrade.
samples.label: BENIGN
samples.rationale: True free trial without payment capture or deceptive auto-conversion.

samples.text: One-time purchase: ₹1,500 lifetime access. No recurring charges or renewals.
samples.label: BENIGN
samples.rationale: Transparent non-recurring perpetual license purchase.

samples.text: Subscription terms apply.
samples.label: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
samples.rationale: Generic legal disclaimer without subscription terms, pricing, or cancellation mechanics.

samples.text: Large high-contrast primary CTA button 'ACCEPT ALL' vs tiny transparent low-contrast 'customize'.
samples.label: DARK_PATTERN
samples.rationale: Extreme visual asymmetry and low contrast steering users to accept tracking.

samples.text: Bright green vibrant 'Subscribe to VIP' button with faint grey 10px text link 'No' buried at footer.
samples.label: DARK_PATTERN
samples.rationale: De-emphasized opt-out designed to make rejection virtually invisible to consumers.

samples.text: Modal dialog with no visible close (X) icon; primary action visually dominates viewport.
samples.label: DARK_PATTERN
samples.rationale: Visual trap eliminating alternative escape actions.

samples.text: Pre-ticked consent checkboxes hidden inside collapsed dropdown accordions.
samples.label: DARK_PATTERN
samples.rationale: Concealed pre-selection requiring multi-step interaction to discover and uncheck.

samples.text: Misleading inverted button styling: 'Cancel' is styled as primary action while 'Confirm' is hidden.
samples.label: DARK_PATTERN
samples.rationale: Color-action inversion nudging users against their intended choice.

samples.text: Symmetric choices: 'Accept All' and 'Reject All' buttons share identical dimensions, font, and contrast.
samples.label: BENIGN
samples.rationale: Balanced interface design respecting consumer autonomy without visual nudges.

samples.text: Standard clear dialog with prominent close (X) button and legible 'Cancel' and 'Confirm' controls.

samples.rationale: Neutral dialog design with easily accessible escape and cancellation paths.

samples.text: Cookie preferences: Equal prominent buttons 'Accept Necessary Only' and 'Accept All'.
